examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A live on/off setting with a clickable label. Space and Enter toggle it when focused.

examples.title: With description
examples.description: Supporting text is linked through aria-describedby. Clicking the label toggles the control; the description stays selectable.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Use checked and onCheckedChange to own the boolean state. The same API and default behavior are available in v1.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Small (36 × 20), default (42 × 24), and large (48 × 28) tracks share the same interaction.

examples.title: Label position
examples.description: Use labelPosition to place the label before or after the control.

examples.title: Disabled and read-only
examples.description: Disabled switches leave the tab order and do not submit. Optional readOnly switches remain focusable and submit their current value without allowing changes.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.description: aria-invalid marks the control red. Explain the problem with description or an external aria-describedby message.

examples.title: Settings list
examples.description: Compose independently controlled switches with labels and supporting copy for a compact preferences panel.

examples.title: Form integration
examples.description: Checked switches contribute name and value to FormData; unchecked and disabled switches are omitted. The default submitted value is on.

examples.title: Right-to-left
examples.description: The thumb travels in the reading direction, including when dir is inherited from a parent.
